The military expeditions to the region where Min dialects are spoken on the border with Zhejiang (Fujian province) were led by Chen Zheng and Chen Yuanguang in 677 and by Wang Chao and Wang Shenzhi in 885.

FINAL_ANSWER: Chen Zheng, Chen Yuanguang, Wang Chao, and Wang Shenzhi

The creator of The Portrait of George Dyer Talking is Francis Bacon. The father of Francis Bacon is Sir Nicholas Bacon. Therefore, the father of the creator of The Portrait of George Dyer Talking is Sir Nicholas Bacon.

FINAL_ANSWER: Sir Nicholas Bacon

The passages do not provide any information about who Rabbi Menachem Mendel Schneersohn, the creator of Derech Mitzvosecha, followed. While we know he authored the work and that he was the third Rebbe of the Chabad Hasidic movement, there is no evidence about his spiritual or religious influences or mentors.

FINAL_ANSWER: UNKNOWN
